verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the baseline documentation, which mentions that Gitleaks writes report output to a findings.json file. That implies JSON report output, but the pack never documents output-format options, SARIF, or how downstream tools consume the reports. missing for 10: explicit documentation of report format flags, SARIF output support, other machine-readable formats (CSV/JUnit), report schema details, independent or hands-on corroboration of downstream integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can emit scan results in machine-readable formats like JSON or SARIF for downstream tooling

citations.quote: report output (findings.json) will only contain new issues
